chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a woman who has given birth (and is in postpartum bleeding), is it permissible for her to marry before she becomes pure? He said: 'Yes, but her husband may not have sexual intercourse with her until she becomes pure.'

key_terms.تَضَعُ الْخَلَإَ: gives birth / is in postpartum state
key_terms.يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: has sexual intercourse / consummates the marriage

ai.seo_question: Can a woman in postpartum bleeding (nifas) get married before she performs ghusl?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the distinction between the validity of the marriage contract (nikah) and the permissibility of sexual intercourse (dakhul) for a postpartum woman. It establishes that while the legal bond is formed immediately, the husband must wait for the cessation of bleeding and ritual purification before consummating the marriage, reflecting the juristic principle that major ritual impurity (hadath akbar) restricts intimacy but not the contract itself.
